'''September 2001 Levittown tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Levittown, NY on 22 September 2001. It is known from Matt Ehrhart's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2985">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-23-levitown-ny-9-22-01d2985/ levitown-ny-9-22-01], DeckTech (Matt "TmastamattC" Ehrhart, 23 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-23-levitown-ny-9-22-01d2985/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Levittown, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Dan Sotelo]]<ref name="tr-d2989" />
